scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker,agents -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @smart-case-buddy/web" "npm run dev --workspace @smart-case-buddy/api" "npm run dev:worker --workspace @smart-case-buddy/api" "python3 apps/agents/src/server.py"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @smart-case-buddy/shared-types && npm run build --workspace @smart-case-buddy/api && npm run build --workspace @smart-case-buddy/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @smart-case-buddy/web && npm run lint --workspace @smart-case-buddy/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @smart-case-buddy/api && npm run test --workspace @smart-case-buddy/web
